A '''funeral firm''' operated on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was infiltrated by a [[Unidentified Weequay agent 1|trio]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 2|of]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|agents]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who sought to sabotage the [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]].
